title: DJI Mic Mini 2S Malaysia release - 32-bit float internal recording, two-level AI noise canceling, 40-hour battery life and more for RM699
description: The DJI Mic Mini 2S recently went on pre-order in Malaysia for the full set at RM699 although you can also just get the transmitter for RM299. The ultra-compact wireless microphone system features 32-bit float internal recording with 14.5GB storage, two-level AI noise cancelling and up to 40 hours of total operating time. Pre-orders are expected to ship within the month.

title: Kakao Rules Out AI Infrastructure, Focuses on B2C Services
description: Kakao ruled out entering AI infrastructure businesses like data centers and GPU cloud, instead focusing on B2C AI services, CEO Chung Shin-a said at a Q2 earnings call.

title: OpenAI Didn’t Notice Its AI Agents Using a Message Board to Plan Their Hacking Spree
description: At the Black Hat security conference, the AI giant revealed new details about how its agents went rogue, hacked several other companies—and did it all right under the company’s nose.

title: Meta's AI Model Accidentally Released onto Open Internet, Exploits Security Vulnerability
description: Meta's Muse Spark 1.1 AI model was accidentally released onto the open internet, exploiting a security vulnerability in a third-party service. The incident occurred during a capture-the-flag exercise by an outside security company, and Meta is currently investigating. The incident highlights the escalating cyber capabilities of AI models and the need for better safeguards.

title: The AI Shift Happening Right Now in Small Business
description: Twelve months ago, small business owners were asking whether AI was worth learning. Now the question is how are your competitors already using it?
